backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a cloud storage backend with file/folder management, user profiles, notifications, sharing, trash, access control, and storage quotas. Includes comprehensive type definitions for files, folders, activities, notifications, and sharing permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented folder navigation features including state management, breadcrumb navigation, back button, file upload in folders, and file isolation with associated test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components and pages, describing routing, authentication, file management, folder navigation, admin features, and UI components with their specific functionality and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS global styles with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the CloudStorage application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component with TanStack Router setup defining routes (home, dashboard, folders, admin, settings, trash), Internet Identity authentication flow, profile setup check, and theme provider integration.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: React component displaying recent file activities in a scrollable card with icons for upload/download/delete actions, relative timestamps, and loading/empty states using useRecentActivities hook.
frontend/src/components/CreateFolderDial: Dialog component for creating new folders with fields for name, visibility, collaborators, color, tags, and description. Validates input and calls the createFolder mutation on submission.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: Alert dialog for confirming permanent deletion of trash items with optional secure wipe. Displays file count, total size, and file list before deletion.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: Dialog for moving files to trash with configurable retention period options (30, 60, or 90 days). Converts selected retention period to nanoseconds for backend storage.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderDial: Dialog for deleting folders with options to either move contents to parent folder or delete all contents. Uses radio buttons to select deletion strategy.
frontend/src/components/DuplicateFileDia: Dialog for resolving duplicate file conflicts during upload with three options: rename with suffix, replace existing files, or skip duplicates. Uses radio group for selection.
frontend/src/components/EditFolderDialog: Dialog for editing folder settings including visibility, collaborators, color, tags, and description. Pre-populates with existing folder metadata and calls editFolder mutation on save.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: Dropdown menu component for filtering files by name, type, date range, and size range with active filter count badge and clear all functionality.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: Main file list component that displays files in grid or list view with search, filter, sort, preview, download, delete, and favorite functionality.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: Modal component for previewing files with support for images, videos, PDFs, and text files, including download functionality.
Debounced search input component with clear button for filtering files by name or type.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: Dropdown menu for sorting files by name, date, size, or type with ascending/descending order indicators.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: Toolbar component that combines search input, filter dropdown, sort dropdown, and grid/list view toggle buttons.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: File upload component with drag-and-drop support, file selection, preview of selected files, and batch upload functionality.
frontend/src/components/FolderBreadcrumb: Renders a breadcrumb navigation component showing the folder hierarchy path from root to the current folder. Uses TanStack Router for navigation and displays clickable links for each folder in the path.
frontend/src/components/FolderContextMen: Provides a dropdown context menu for folder actions (rename, edit, move, delete) that appears on hover. Only displays menu options if the user is the folder owner or an admin.
frontend/src/components/FolderDropZone.t: Implements a drag-and-drop zone wrapper component that handles file drop events and provides visual feedback during drag operations. Accepts files and triggers an onDrop callback with the dropped files and target folder ID.
frontend/src/components/FolderFAB.tsx: Renders a floating action button (FAB) for mobile devices that expands to show 'New Folder' and 'Upload' options. Hidden on desktop screens (md breakpoint and above).
frontend/src/components/FolderToolbar.ts: Displays a desktop toolbar with page title, description, and action buttons for creating new folders and uploading files. Buttons show icons only on small screens and include text labels on larger screens.
frontend/src/components/FolderUploadProg: Shows a fixed-position card displaying upload progress for multiple files with individual progress bars, pause/resume, and cancel controls. Positioned at bottom-right of the screen and hidden when no uploads are active.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main application header with search bar, notification bell with unread count badge, theme toggle, and user dropdown menu. Provides navigation to settings and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that combines Header, Sidebar, and main content area with TanStack Router Outlet. Manages sidebar open/closed state and applies responsive margin to main content.
frontend/src/components/MoveFolderDialog: Modal dialog for moving a folder to a different parent location with radio button selection. Prevents moving folders into their own descendants and displays available destination folders with color indicators.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Displays a scrollable list of user notifications with icons based on type, read/unread status, and mark-as-read functionality. Shows an empty state when no notifications exist.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Displays a horizontal scrollable list of favorited/starred files with preview and download actions. Shows an empty state when no files are pinned.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: A profile setup form component that collects user name and email on first login. Validates input and saves profile data via mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Provides three quick action buttons for uploading files, creating folders, and creating text documents. Handles file upload with progress feedback and quota validation.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Displays a scrollable list of recent file activities (upload, delete, restore) with icons and timestamps. Shows loading skeleton and empty state when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/RenameFolderDial: A dialog component for renaming folders with validation for name length and required fields. Uses mutation hook to persist changes.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: Dialog for restoring deleted files with options to restore to original location or a custom path. Displays original locations for selected items.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays files shared by other users with owner information, permission badges, and view/download actions. Shows empty state when no files are shared.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Renders a collapsible sidebar with navigation menu items (Home, My Files, Shared, Recent, Trash, Settings, Admin), folder tree with expand/collapse functionality, and a storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Displays a horizontal scrollable list of AI-suggested files based on user activity, showing file name, reason for suggestion, access count, and action buttons for viewing and downloading.
Shows a detailed storage usage card with progress bar, used/available breakdown, percentage display, and a warning message when storage is 90% or more full.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Compact storage indicator component displaying a progress bar and available storage in MB, with color-coded warnings based on usage percentage (75%, 90% thresholds).
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides filtering UI for trash items with search by filename, file type selection, owner filter (admin only), date range picker, and original path search, with a clear filters button.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Displays trash storage usage as a card with progress bar showing percentage of total quota consumed by deleted files, indicating reclaimable space.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin component showing a table of all users with their storage usage, quota, and usage percentage, with ability to edit individual user quotas via a dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Custom React hook that manages file filtering state (name, type, date range, size range) and provides functions to filter FileMetadata arrays based on these criteria.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Custom React hook that manages search query state and filters FileMetadata arrays by matching file names or extensions against the search query.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Custom React hook that manages file sorting state (by name, date, size, or type) with ascending/descending order and provides a function to sort FileMetadata arrays.
frontend/src/hooks/useFolderQueries.ts: React Query hooks for folder operations including listing, creating, renaming, editing, moving, and deleting folders with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profiles, roles, file operations, and various data types (trash, activities, notifications, favorites, suggestions, shared files, storage info) with mutations and cache management.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors including primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function that combines clsx and tailwind-merge to merge Tailwind CSS class names with proper conflict resolution.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks user role authorization and displays system statistics cards, user storage manager, and activity feed for administrators.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page component that toggles between a file list view and file upload view using state. Displays header with title and action buttons for switching views.
frontend/src/pages/FoldersPage.tsx: Folder management page with nested folder navigation, breadcrumbs, and file listing. Supports folder operations (create, rename, edit, move, delete) via dialogs and context menus, with drag-and-drop file upload.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main landing page displaying a dashboard with storage overview, quick actions, pinned files, recent activity, shared files, notifications, and smart suggestions components in a grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with Internet Identity authentication, featuring a two-column layout with product features (encryption, cloud access, privacy, speed) and a sign-in card.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page for managing account information, trash retention period, theme preferences, notifications, and security options. Includes logout functionality and displays user profile data.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: Trash management page displaying deleted files in a sortable table with bulk selection, restore, and permanent delete operations. Includes admin filtering, storage indicator, and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with container settings, border radius variables, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting a folder management system with two sections (My Files and My Folder), known issues with folder creation/navigation in My Folder section, and feature requests for nested folder support with breadcrumb navigation.
